executable_checked_properties.WARNING: NOTHING IN THIS SECTION IS A THEOREM. These are properties checked by executing code against finitely many inputs. A passing test shows the property held on the inputs tried; it does not establish the property for all inputs. This section exists so the distinction between 'tested' and 'proved' is recorded rather than blurred — per the specification: do not call a test vector a theorem.

properties.property: The transcript encoding is injective: decodeTranscript recovers exactly the (tag, fields) pair that built the bytes.
properties.method: round-trip over a generated corpus plus targeted ambiguous-concatenation attacks (delimiter-in-data, shifted field boundaries, differing field counts)
properties.scope_limit: finite corpus; not a proof of injectivity over all inputs

properties.property: Every inclusion proof produced for a tree verifies against that tree's root, for all leaf counts 1..17.
properties.method: exhaustive over sizes 1..17 and every index within each size
properties.scope_limit: bounded sizes only; soundness against a computationally bounded adversary additionally depends on ASSUMPTION-HASH-COLLISION-RESISTANCE

properties.property: A valid proof for index i fails at every other index j.
properties.method: exhaustive over all wrong positions for an 8-leaf tree

properties.property: An internal node hash cannot be presented as a leaf.
An MMR truncated from n leaves to k < n never reproduces the genuine k-leaf root (leaf count is bound into the root).
Rewriting record k of a hash chain is detected, and reported at index k.
properties.method: exhaustive over every index of a 5-record chain

properties.property: Claimed lineage containing a cycle is rejected with LINEAGE_CYCLE and terminates under a step budget.
properties.method: 500-node cycle, deep chains, self-parent and duplicate-parent cases
properties.scope_limit: specific adversarial graphs. This is NOT the 'Direct Acyclicity' Lean theorem referenced in project prose — no such compiled declaration exists.

properties.property: No AEAD failure path returns an object carrying a plaintext field.
properties.method: four distinct failure modes (wrong AAD, zeroed tag, zeroed ciphertext, truncated tag) across every implemented suite

properties.property: An unknown algorithm id raises UNKNOWN_ALGORITHM and a registered-but-unwired id raises UNSUPPORTED_ALGORITHM; neither ever dispatches.
RSA-PKCS1v1.5 verifies historical signatures and refuses generation in two independent places.
properties.method: positive historical-verification vector plus refusal assertions on signBytes and generateKeyPair

properties.property: Every unavailable provider raises PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE with a specific reason for every operation, and returns no value.
properties.method: all 7 operations across all 19 detected-unavailable providers

properties.property: Every registry row marked COMPLETE is reachable through its family dispatcher, declares the digest length it actually produces, and references only paths that exist on disk.
properties.scope_limit: none within the registry; this is a total check over the registry contents
